whyItMatters: Server header discloses its release number.
actions: Suppress the banner using ServerTokens Prod.
Normalise version banners at the proxy or CDN.
Keep the component patched; a hidden version is not a fixed version.
verification: Re-request the page and confirm the banner no longer carries a release number; check an error response and a static asset too, because they can be produced by a different code path.
